text:
[RFCS.1.3] An event trace records every observable event of one DS engine
session: every input the engine consumed, every observable it produced, and
the structural atoms that frame them. The three classes, and what a reader
must do with each, are [RFCS.17.1] and [RFCS.17.5]; the atom census is
[RFCS.3.1].

The engine emits these events through the typed callback surface ([NCBK.2])
and performs no I/O of its own. A trace file is one serialisation of that
sequence, and producing it is the integrator's choice ([LFST.2.1]).

---
